g.text: ActiveHub mandatory use cases - acceptance implementation
Green: implemented mandatory behavior; verification scope is in FINAL_ACCEPTANCE.md.
Grey [S] cases are optional and are not part of this delivery.
Every protected action checks server role, owner and active account.
System S1-S7 are mandatory IDs. Q-01 through Q-04 use the recorded owner decisions.
Q-05 classification follows the latest decision in ASSUMPTIONS.md.
